title: Sherpa-UI page definition
description: One page, as JSON: its data source and its components' configuration. Its markup is its Context's, in app.v1.json. The provider's open() reads it; checkPage() checks its names. docs/PAGE-DEFINITION.md

id.description: The page's id: its Views, its saved Views and its kept Query are filed under it.

ui.description: Each component's configuration, by id, set before it is answered, as a View's ui is.

savedFilters.description: The page's own saved filters, by id: listed beside a reader's, and applied as theirs are.
